about: Build hooks reviewed for the in-place upgrade (tools/make-upgrade.sh). A hook whose SHA-256 differs from the one here stops the bundle build: read the change, decide whether the upgrader must repeat it (upgrade: replay = the bundle runs the hook as it is on the installed system; partial = zeta_upgrade.py does the parts that matter, see 'how'; conditional = only when its input changed; skip = nothing to do on an installed system), update zeta_upgrade.py if needed, then run tools/make-upgrade.sh --accept-hooks.

0100-zeta-branding.hook.chroot.how: version in os-release, issue, motd (SDDM and GRUB theme files carry it in the bundle); file modes; systemctl enable lines that are new since 2.5; glib schemas; icon caches; boot splash images and initramfs when the boot theme or the brand logo changed; update-grub when /etc/default/grub.d changed. Diversions, time zone and bashrc lines are already on a 2.5 system.

0110-zeta-languages.hook.chroot.how: when languages.json changed: the new locales are enabled in /etc/locale.gen and generated; the system language is never reset

0200-zeta-vosk.hook.chroot.how: speech recognition models are not upgraded

0300-zeta-ollama.hook.chroot.how: Ollama runtime (GPU libraries left out, as the hook does) and the ollama.service text written by this hook; models are not bundled

0350-zeta-hyprland-patched.hook.chroot.how: replayed only when the patched Hyprland version differs from the installed one

0400-zeta-hyprbars.hook.chroot.how: replayed together with 0350 (title bars rebuilt for the new Hyprland)

0600-zeta-legal.hook.chroot.how: legal documents regenerated with the new version and packages

9990-zeta-upgrade.hook.chroot.how: apt-get update and dist-upgrade with the same options; Hyprland must stay the +zeta build

9993-zeta-apt-repo.hook.chroot.how: the bundle installs the same zeta-rays-release package itself

9995-zeta-final-language.hook.chroot.how: would reset the language chosen by the user

9996-zeta-speed.hook.chroot.how: ZETA Python code precompiled and icon caches rebuilt
